plain_text:
Concord Trails Subcommittee Meeting Minutes 
 
9/9/2026 Council Chambers Room, City Hall Annex 
Members Present:  
Fran Philippe, Andrew Gould (Secretary), Max Hankard (Alternate), Mark Cheever (Chair), Jason 
Massa, Nick Holmes (Vice Chair), and Jeff Lewis (Conservation Commission). 
Staff: Kearsten O’Brien (Senior Planner), Ron Klemarczyk (City Forester), Carl Matson (Trail 
Ranger). 
Absent: Rik Van Riel, Rebecca Ross and Judy Weatherby (Alternate), 
Guests: Matt Bowser, Stacey Brown 
  
1. Meeting called to order at 5:17 PM.  
 
2. Consent Agenda 
 
 a. Approval of the 8/12/2026 meeting minutes. Fran Philippe made the motion.    
       Nick Holmes seconded the motion. Unanimous. 
 
 b. City Forester Report: accepted 
• Ron Klemarczyk cut trees along a few trails and worked on boundary 
marking at the Hooksett Turnpike property. 
         Trail Ranger Report: accepted 
• Carl Matson has been trimming Winant Park and the West End Farm Trail. 
• Mast Yard- no issues to report. 
• MRGT/ sunﬂower trail- no issues to report. 
• Russell Martin Park- no issues to report. 
• Morono Park trails- removed old signs. 
• Contoocook River Park- cut trees. 
• Locke Road- more illegal dumping. 
 
3. New Business 
 
a) Fran Philippe discussed labeling or not labeling speciﬁc trails “mountain bike 
trails” on the city maps. Matt Bowser spoke to the Trails Subcommittee about 
keeping Concord’s trails multi-use trails and to not discourage other groups from 
using speciﬁc trails. The Subcommittee decided to not identify the three 
mountain bike trails as such. 
 
4. Old Business 
 a. Marsh Loop trail discontinuance discussion: The Trails Subcommittee went 
through the procedure for discontinuing a trail guidance document and discussed each
of the points. Fran Philippe made the motion to not discontinue the trail. Mark Cheever 
seconded the motion. Unanimous. 
• Matt Bowser recommended narrowing and fixing the trail from becoming too 
wide 
• Ron Klemarczyk will investigate possible reroute options nearby. 
 b.  West End Farm Trail guide description- The Trails Subcommittee reviewed and made 
edits to the description. 
 
 
5. Other business:  
a. Hikes 
• September 19, 2026, Wendy to lead a hike at Swope  
 
6. Staﬀ Updates: None 
 
7. Concord Trails Plan Chapters 4&5 discussion: Did not discuss. 
 
8. Adjourn at 6:45. Nick Holmes made the motion, Fran Philippe seconded the motion, 
unanimous.  
 
 
Andrew Gould 
Secretary
